plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells, again and again on his show, how Mario Woods and his partner Michael Johnson were on duty at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977 and were, according to Woods's memories recovered under hypnosis, abducted. Michels lists the details: a signal exchange, at least five missing hours, a truck found at a dam, mud in a frozen field, burns a doctor found, and drawings of the craft, drawing on the book UFOs and Nukes by Robert Hastings, and he says he later reunited the two men. If true, it would mean non-humans took airmen guarding American nuclear weapons.
